## Overview

Part of the [**Data Science Projects Collection**](https://github.com/PaulChanCyber/Data-Science-Project-) (Phone Price analysis)—Smartphone price analysis across brands, specs, and release generations.

## Problem & Data

Rapid SKU turnover makes fair pricing difficult for buyers and resellers.

## Approach

Scrape phone listings, normalize specs, analyze depreciation curves and brand premiums.

## Technologies

Python · pandas · Seaborn · Jupyter

## Outcomes

Spec-adjusted price benchmarks and brand/model depreciation insights.
